about_the_game:
Goalgetter is the first-person soccer career simulation. In our demo, you can replay the World Cups of 1954 and 2022 to get a first impression of the game. Relive the Miracle of Bern or correct the weak performance of the German national team in 2022. Would you like to recreate the Miracle of Bern or lead the Argentine Albiceleste to victory in 2022 with your goals?

Now also with Euro 2024 and a demo of the complete game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64bit MS Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.6 GHz
  • Memory: 6 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphic Card with DirectX 9
  • Sound Card: DirectX9 Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64bit MS Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3.0 GHz
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 / AMD Radeon R9 280X
  • Sound Card: DirectX9 Compatible
